lines.zh: : Nodoka，你成天说那些下流的话……可从来没人真的见过或听说过你……做过其中任何一件。

lines.en: : Are you actually as interested in sex as you claim to be? Or is this some sort of...disguise or front you’re trying to put on or...up, respectively.
lines.zh: : 你真的像你声称的那样对性感兴趣吗？还是说这只是某种……你想伪装出来的、或分别戴上的面具？

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween30
: I, too, am curious to know this truth.
lines.zh: : 我也很好奇这个真心话的答案。

lines.en: : I’ve always found it particularly strange how forward you are.
lines.zh: : 我一直觉得你过于直白这点特别奇怪。

lines.en: : At first, I assumed it to just be the way commoner women conduct themselves.
lines.zh: : 起初我以为那只是平民女子的做派。

lines.en: : But as time passes by and no one measures up to the things you say, I’m beginning to wonder if you are a special case.
lines.zh: : 可随着时间流逝，没有一个人能配得上你说过的那些话，我开始怀疑你是不是个特例。

lines.en: : So...the question is whether or not I’m actually just saying all of those things or if I’m truly interested in them?
lines.zh: : 所以……问题是，我那些话到底只是说说而已，还是说我真的对那些事感兴趣？

lines.en: : Precisely. And, if your answer is the former, {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 正是。而且如果你的答案是前者，那又是{i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween31
: Well, adding {i}another{/i} question to your first one would be breaking the rules. So if the answer {i}is{/i} the former, you’ll have to wait at least one more round to figure out why.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在你的第一个问题上再加一个问题就违规了。所以如果答案{i}是{/i}前者，你至少得再等一轮才能知道原因。

lines.en: : Fortunately, that won’t be an issue- as all of the things I say are not exaggerated, nor are they a disguise or front.
lines.zh: : 幸好不会有这个问题——因为我说的所有事情既没有夸大，也不是什么伪装或面具。

lines.en: : So that...strange, pervertedly curious persona actually is the real {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以那个……古怪的、变态般好奇的人格，真的就是{i}你{/i}本人？

lines.en: : Ding ding ding. The class rep has figured it out.
lines.zh: : 叮叮叮。班长答对了。

lines.en: : I don’t get it, though. If you’re so interested in that sort of thing, why aren’t you trying to get a girlfriend or...boyfriend or something?
lines.zh: : 我还是不懂。既然你对那种事那么感兴趣，为什么不去试着找个女朋友或者……男朋友什么的？

lines.en: : You do like boys, right? I’ve only ever heard you talk about girls before.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢男生吧？我只听你聊过女生。

lines.en: : So many questions. Do you need a refresher on how this game works, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 问题真多。需要我帮你复习一下这个游戏的规则吗，Makoto？

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween32
: Of course not. You’re just a...confusing person.
lines.zh: : 当然不用。你只是个……让人费解的人。

lines.en: : Will {i}you{/i} be my girlfriend, Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto，{i}你{/i}愿意做我的女朋友吗？

lines.en: : No. But I feel like even if I said yes, you’d back off.
lines.zh: : 不愿意。但我觉得就算我说愿意，你也会退缩。

lines.en: : Then say yes and see what happens.
lines.zh: : 那就说愿意，看看会怎样。

lines.en: : You really won’t explain your rationale? I’m genuinely curious.
lines.zh: : 你真的不解释一下你的逻辑？我是真的好奇。

lines.en: : I think I’d like to remain an enigma for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 我想再当一阵子谜题。

lines.en: : But maybe next round, I'll pick truth again and come clean just for you~
lines.zh: : 不过也许下一轮我会再选真心话，只为你一个人坦白~

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween33
: Hah...we all know that’s not going to happen now...
lines.zh: : 哈……我们现在都知道那是不可能发生的了……

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween34
: Buuuut anyway...it looks like it’s the blushing kitten’s turn.
lines.zh: : 不~~~~~过话说回来……看起来轮到那只脸红的小猫咪了。

lines.en: : I already told you, the costume’s hot. I’m not blushing.
lines.zh: : 我都说了，是衣服太热。我没脸红。

lines.en: : Right, right. Apologies.
lines.zh: : 对对。抱歉。

lines.en: : I take it you’re going to follow in everyone else’s footsteps in saying “truth” instead of paving a path for yourself with a dare?
lines.zh: : 想必你也要步其他人的后尘说「真心话」，而不是用大冒险替自己开路了？

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween35
: Nyahahah!~ That’s where you’re wrong, Nodoka!
lines.zh: : 喵哈哈！~ 这你可就猜错了，Nodoka！

lines.en: : I’ve been planning on breaking the combo ever since the start, nyaa!~
lines.zh: : 我从一开始就打算打破这个连击了，喵！~

lines.en: : But...it wouldn’t have been a combination at the start...
lines.zh: : 可是……一开始还不算连击吧……

lines.en: : Hit me with a dare! Show me what you got!
lines.zh: : 拿大冒险砸我吧！让我看看你有多大本事！

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : Super sure! Uta-nyan can handle anything!
lines.zh: : 超级确定！Uta-nyan 什么都承受得住！

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Then I dare you to saunter on over to the man in the back of the room, stand on your tiny little tiptoes, and passionately kiss him in the middle of the Halloween party.
lines.zh: : 那么我要求你晃到房间后面那个男人身边，踮起你小小的脚尖，在万圣节派对的正中间热情地吻他。

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween36
: Uh...wh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什……什么？

lines.en: : You’re the one who chose a dare. All things considered, I’d say this one sounds pretty simple.
lines.zh: : 是你自己选的大冒险。综合来看，我觉得这个要求听起来相当简单。

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween37
: Absolutely not!
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！

lines.en: : We clearly stated that Sensei would not be brought into any of the questions or dares in this game {i}specifically{/i} to avoid a situation like this.
lines.zh: : 我们明明说好了，Sensei 不会被卷进这个游戏的任何问题或大冒险里，{i}就是{/i}为了避免出现这种局面。

lines.en: : Yeah. Not a fucking chance.
lines.zh: : 对。门儿都没有。

lines.en: : You can’t just kiss someone who doesn’t want you to kiss them. That’s assault.
lines.zh: : 你不能就这么去亲一个不想被你亲的人。那是性骚扰。

lines.en: : Oh? Are you implying that Sensei wouldn’t want to kiss our adorable little Uta-nyan?
lines.zh: : 哦？你是在暗示 Sensei 不会想亲我们可爱的 Uta-nyan 吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I am.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : No offense to Uta, of course. But Sensei is off limits for this and you need to think of something else.
lines.zh: : 当然没有要冒犯 Uta 的意思。但 Sensei 在这件事上是禁区，你得想个别的大冒险。

lines.en: : Agreed. This is entirely unacceptable.
lines.zh: : 同意。这完全不能接受。

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween38
: Well, like...what if it’s just on the cheek or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 那个，比如说……只是亲一下脸颊什么的呢？

lines.en: : Everybody in the room knows we’re playin’ a game, so they’ll all just think it’s part of that.
lines.zh: : 屋里所有人都知道我们在玩游戏，所以他们只会觉得那是游戏的一部分。

lines.en: : Miku! You can’t seriously be siding with Nodoka on this, can you?
lines.zh: : Miku！你该不会真站 Nodoka 那边吧？

lines.en: : I’m not sidin’ with anybody...I just don’t think it’s a big deal if it’s a little peck on the cheek.
lines.zh: : 我没站谁那边……我只是觉得，如果只是轻轻亲一下脸颊，那也没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Would get everybody to stop yellin’ too.
lines.zh: : 而且还能让大家别再吵了。

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween39
: Oh...I’m sorry...
: I wasn’t even thinking about the noise.
lines.zh: : 我都没想到噪音那回事。

lines.en: : Nah. I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 没事。我没事。

lines.en: : I just...don’t want any fights breakin’ out over somethin’ that...doesn’t really change anything...
lines.zh: : 我只是……不想有人为了一件……其实改变不了什么的事……吵起来……

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween40
: Is it...too late to pick a truth instead?
lines.zh: : 现在……改选真心话还来得及吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...How about this one?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那这个怎么样？

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} to kiss Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}亲 Sensei 吗？

lines.en: : I feel like answerin’ that is even more dangerous than the cheek thing...
lines.zh: : 我觉得回答这个比亲脸颊那事还危险……

lines.en: : The poor kitty.
lines.zh: : 可怜的小猫咪。

lines.en: : You can always back out of the game if you’d like, Uta-nyan.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意，随时可以退出游戏，Uta-nyan。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} just a game after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟这只{i}是{/i}个游戏。

lines.en: : Everything that comes out of the circle is all in good fun.
lines.zh: : 从圈子里说出去的一切，都只是闹着玩而已。

lines.en: : Besides, if you {i}do{/i} want to kiss our teacher, now would be a perfect opportunity.
lines.zh: : 再说了，如果你{i}真{/i}想亲我们的老师，现在可是个绝佳的机会。

lines.en: : But...we’re not supposed to be adding him to the game! We said we wouldn’t...
lines.zh: : 可是……我们说好了不把他加进游戏里的！我们说过的……

lines.en: : Nodoka, seriously. Just think up another dare.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，说真的。想个别的大冒险吧。

lines.en: : I agree with Chika.
lines.zh: : 我同意 Chika。

lines.en: : It appears it may be democracy’s time to shine, then.
lines.zh: : 看来，或许该轮到民主发光发热了。

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween41
: Makoto and Chika have vocalized their agreeance with the core rule this game was built upon.
lines.zh: : Makoto 和 Chika 已经表态支持这个游戏赖以建立的核心规则。

lines.en: : However, new circumstances have arisen and now Miku and I think a minor change would be both acceptable and beneficial to the game’s enjoyment for all.
lines.zh: : 然而，新的情况出现了，现在我和 Miku 认为，做一点小小的改动是可以接受的，也有利于所有人的游戏体验。

lines.en: : My initial dare is now formally amended to a simple kiss on the cheek, just to clarify.
lines.zh: : 为明确起见，我最初的大冒险现在正式修正为：简单地亲一下脸颊。

lines.en: : The only members who have yet to vote are Uta, who is exempt due to a conflict of interest-
lines.zh: : 唯一还没投票的成员是 Uta，她因利益冲突而回避——

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween42
: And Touka...
lines.zh: : 以及 Touka……

lines.en: : I am...the deciding factor in this vote?
lines.zh: : 我……是这次投票的决定性一票？

lines.en: : But that’s so much pressure...
lines.zh: : 可这也太有压力了……

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : All you need to really do is tell the circle whether or not you think a kiss on the cheek is romantic or not.
lines.zh: : 你真正要做的，只是告诉这个圈子：你认为亲脸颊算不算浪漫。

lines.en: : Do you see a problem with one or more members, if dared, kissing each other on the cheek?
lines.zh: : 你认为，一位或多位成员在大冒险的要求下互相亲脸颊，有什么问题吗？

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween43
: Well...in my family...things like that aren’t called romantic...
lines.zh: : 嗯……在我家里……那种事不叫浪漫……

lines.en: : My father kisses both my sister and me on the cheek quite frequently. And I do the same with my mother and...even other extended members of the family.
lines.zh: : 我父亲就经常亲我和我妹妹的脸颊。我也会这样亲我母亲，甚至……其他那些关系更远的家族成员。

lines.en: : I don’t believe there to be any romantic significance to such a thing and...
lines.zh: : 我认为那种举动不具备任何浪漫意味，而且……

lines.en: : I think I’d have to side with...Miku and Nodoka...
lines.zh: : 我想我得站……Miku 和 Nodoka 那边……

lines.en: : Seriously?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah, it {i}is{/i} just the cheek. But you don’t think it’s weird to just do that in the middle of a party?
lines.zh: : 我是说……对，{i}确实{/i}只是脸颊。但你不觉得在派对正中间做那种事很奇怪吗？

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween44
: I’m afraid that wasn’t the question I was asked...
lines.zh: : 恐怕我问到的并不是那个问题……

lines.en: : Then it’s not too late to revise the poll to-
lines.zh: : 那现在修订投票内容还来——

lines.en: : No objections were made to the poll when presented and time has already been yielded for both parties on the opposing side.
lines.zh: : 投票提出时无人反对，而且已经给过反方双方发言的时间了。

lines.en: : As such, Uta-nyan must now either abide by the amended rules of the game and kiss Sensei or...stop playing.
lines.zh: : 因此，Uta-nyan 现在要么遵守修正后的游戏规则去亲 Sensei，要么……退出游戏。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Uta, what will it be?
lines.zh: : Uta，你选哪个？

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween45
: Truth or dare sure can get serious, huh?
lines.zh: : 真心话大冒险还真是会变得很严肃啊。

lines.en: : You feelin’ okay, Uta? It’s just a little kiss on the cheek. It's not like-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Uta？只是亲一下脸颊而已。又不是——

lines.en: scene truthordarehalloween46
: You're...
: Doin'...anything else...
lines.zh: : 这是在……做别的事……
